info.title: Swagger Petstore - OpenAPI 3.0
info.description:
This is a sample Pet Store Server based on the OpenAPI 3.0 specification. You can find out more about Swagger at [https://swagger.io](https://swagger.io). In the third iteration of the pet store, we've switched to the design first approach!

## Versioning Strategy

This API follows a semantic versioning strategy (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH) as defined at https://semver.org. The current version is `1.0.27`.

- **MAJOR** versions introduce backwards-incompatible breaking changes.
- **MINOR** versions add backwards-compatible functionality.
- **PATCH** versions ship backwards-compatible bug fixes.

The version compatibility policy guarantees that all `1.x` releases remain wire-compatible with `1.0`. Clients written against `1.0.x` will continue to interoperate with any `1.y.z` server where `y >= 0`.

## Breaking Changes & Changelog

A full changelog of breaking changes between major versions is published at https://github.com/swagger-api/swagger-petstore/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md. Each breaking change entry references the affected operations and schemas and includes the deprecation date.

## Migration Guides

Migration and upgrade guides for each major release are published at https://swagger.io/docs/specification/migration/. The migration guide describes endpoint-level changes, request/response payload deltas, and recommended client-side adaptations.

Some useful links:
- [The Pet Store repository](https://github.com/swagger-api/swagger-petstore)
- [The source API definition for the Pet Store](https://github.com/swagger-api/swagger-petstore/blob/master/src/main/resources/openapi.yaml)

Order.description: A purchase order placed by a customer for a specific pet, including ship date, quantity, and status.

Category.description: A grouping classification used to organize pets (for example: Dogs, Cats, Birds).

User.description: A registered Petstore user account, including profile information, contact details, and account status.

Tag.description: A free-form label that can be attached to a pet to aid in search and discovery.

Pet.description: A pet resource available in the Petstore catalog, including name, photos, optional category and tags, and current store status.

ApiResponse.description: A generic envelope used for non-resource responses such as upload confirmations or status messages.

Error.description: A standard error response envelope returned for any 4xx or 5xx status code, carrying a stable error code, a human-readable message, and optional structured details to aid client-side handling and debugging.

code.description: Stable, machine-readable error code (for example: invalid_argument, not_found, rate_limited, internal_error).

message.description: Human-readable error message safe to surface to the end user.
message.example: The supplied petId is not a valid 64-bit integer.

details.description: Optional structured details enumerating per-field validation errors or auxiliary diagnostic information.

requestId.description: Server-generated correlation identifier for the failing request, suitable for support escalations.

ErrorDetail.description: A structured per-field or per-cause entry attached to an Error response, used for validation diagnostics.

field.description: JSON pointer or dotted-path identifying the offending field within the request payload.

issue.description: Human-readable description of the specific validation issue for this field.

X-Rate-Limit-Limit.description: The maximum number of requests permitted in the current rate-limiting window.

X-Rate-Limit-Remaining.description: The number of requests still permitted in the current rate-limiting window.

X-Rate-Limit-Reset.description: Epoch time (seconds since 1970-01-01 UTC) at which the current rate-limiting window resets.

BadRequest.description: The request was malformed or contained invalid parameters.

NotFound.description: The requested resource could not be found.

UnprocessableEntity.description: The request was syntactically valid but failed semantic validation.

Unauthorized.description: Authentication is required and either missing or invalid.

Forbidden.description: The caller is authenticated but not authorized to perform the operation.

example.message: The caller is not authorized to perform this operation.

TooManyRequests.description: The client has exceeded the allowed rate limit for this operation.

Retry-After.description: Seconds the client should wait before retrying the request.

example.message: Rate limit exceeded; retry after the indicated interval.
An unexpected error occurred. Please retry or contact support.

Pet.description: Pet object that needs to be added to the store

petstore_auth.description: OAuth2 implicit flow used for end-user-delegated access. Two scopes are exposed: `read:pets` for read-only access to pets and `write:pets` for mutating pet and store resources.

scopes.write:pets: Grants permission to modify pets and store resources owned by the authenticated user.
scopes.read:pets: Grants permission to read pets and store resources visible to the authenticated user.

api_key.description: Server-issued API key used for service-to-service authentication. The key must be supplied in the `api_key` request header for every protected operation.
api_key.name: api_key
